en.s: Maya inscriptions record the arrival of Siyaj K’ak’ at Tikal, in present-day Guatemala, on a date conventionally correlated to 16 January 378. The arrival coincided with the death of Tikal’s ruler and a major political transition; its exact circumstances remain debated.
en.n: The date uses the conventional correlation of the Maya inscription.

zh.t: 西亚赫·卡克抵达蒂卡尔
zh.s: 玛雅铭文记载，西亚赫·卡克于通常换算为公元378年1月16日的那一天抵达蒂卡尔，即今危地马拉境内。当日也记载了蒂卡尔统治者的死亡，随后当地发生重大权力更替；事件的具体经过仍有争议。
zh.n: 日期采用玛雅铭文的常用历法换算。

en.s: In 549–550 AD, Rome was besieged for the third time during the Gothic War (535–554), as Byzantine forces defended against an Ostrogothic (Goths) army under their King Totila. Within the first five years of the war, the Byzantines had conquered much of Italy, culminating in the capture of the capital of the Gothic kingdom in 540. However, corruption and harsh taxation reignited Gothic resistance under Totila, who reversed many Byzantine territorial gains in a few years. In June 549, Totila besieged Rome, facing a Byzantine garrison of about 3,000 troops under Diogenes, who prepared for a prolonged defense with stored food. Totila imposed a blockade to starve the Byzantine garrison. Discontented defenders, unhappy over years of unpaid wages, accepted promises made by him and opened the gate to the Goths on 16 January 550.

zh.s: 公元549年至550年，哥特战争期间，罗马第三次遭到围攻：拜占庭守军抵御托提拉国王率领的东哥特军队。战争头五年，拜占庭征服意大利大部分地区，并于540年攻占哥特王国首都，但腐败与重税又激起抵抗。549年6月，托提拉围困罗马，守将第欧根尼率约3000人储粮备战。托提拉封锁城市，试图迫使守军因饥饿投降。因多年欠饷而不满的部分守军接受其许诺，于550年1月16日打开城门，让哥特军入城。

en.t: Abd al-Rahman III proclaims himself caliph of Córdoba
en.s: On 16 January 929, Abd al-Rahman III, the Umayyad ruler of Córdoba, proclaimed himself caliph. The proclamation elevated his title from emir and asserted his authority against rival caliphates.

zh.t: 阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世称哈里发
zh.s: 929年1月16日，科尔多瓦的倭马亚统治者阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世宣布自任哈里发，将头衔由埃米尔提升为哈里发，并以此向其他哈里发政权宣示权威。

en.t: Crusades: The Council of Nablus is held, establishing the earliest surviving written laws of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem
en.s: The Council of Nablus, held on January 16, 1120, was a council of ecclesiastic and secular lords in the crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem.

zh.s: 1120年1月16日，十字军耶路撒冷王国的教会及世俗领主在纳布卢斯举行会议。

en.t: Saint Marcellus’s storm surge on the North Sea coast
en.s: On 16 January 1362, the storm known as Saint Marcellus’s flood brought destructive storm-surge conditions to the German North Sea coast. The wider storm affected the British Isles, the Netherlands, northern Germany and Denmark, reshaping coastal land and destroying settlements.
en.n: This date refers to the traditionally recorded continental storm-surge phase of a multi-day storm. Historical accounts differ over the storm’s timing and the death toll.

zh.t: 圣马塞勒斯风暴潮袭击北海沿岸
zh.s: 1362年1月16日，被称为圣马塞勒斯洪灾的风暴在德国北海沿岸引发破坏性风暴潮。这场持续多日的风暴还波及不列颠群岛、荷兰和丹麦，改变了海岸地形，摧毁了许多聚落。
zh.n: 此日期对应欧洲大陆史料通常记载的风暴潮阶段。风暴持续多日，各史料对具体时间和死亡人数的记载存在差异。

en.s: The Epiphany Rising was a failed rebellion against King Henry IV of England in early January 1400.

en.s: Bigod's rebellion of January 1537 was an armed rebellion by English Catholics in Cumberland and Westmorland against King Henry VIII and the English Reformation Parliament. It was led by Sir Francis Bigod, of Settrington in the East Riding of Yorkshire.
en.n: Bigod's Rebellion, an armed insurrection attempting to resist the English Reformation, begins.

zh.s: 1537年1月，英格兰天主教徒在坎伯兰和威斯特摩兰发动比戈德叛乱，反对亨利八世国王及英格兰宗教改革议会。叛乱由约克郡东区塞特林顿的弗朗西斯·比戈德爵士领导。

en.t: Philip II succeeds to the Spanish crowns
en.s: On 16 January 1556, Philip II succeeded his father, Charles I, as ruler of the Spanish crowns. His accession to Portugal followed separately in 1580.

zh.t: 腓力二世继承西班牙王位
zh.s: 1556年1月16日，腓力二世从父亲卡洛斯一世手中继承西班牙各王国的王位。他于1580年另行继承葡萄牙王位。

en.t: Thomas Howard, Duke of Norfolk, convicted of treason
en.s: On 16 January 1572, Thomas Howard, 4th Duke of Norfolk, was tried for his involvement in the Ridolfi plot against Elizabeth I. After a twelve-hour trial, a jury of peers unanimously found him guilty of high treason and he was sentenced to death.

zh.t: 诺福克公爵托马斯·霍华德被判叛国罪
zh.s: 1572年1月16日，第四代诺福克公爵托马斯·霍华德因卷入反对伊丽莎白一世的里多尔菲阴谋而受审。审判持续十二小时，贵族陪审团一致认定他犯有叛国罪，判处死刑。

en.t: Publication of the first part of Don Quixote
en.s: On 16 January 1605, the first part of Miguel de Cervantes’s Don Quixote was published in Madrid, Spain. Permission to publish had been granted in September 1604, and printing was completed that December.

zh.s: 1605年1月16日，米格尔·德·塞万提斯的《堂吉诃德》第一部在西班牙马德里出版。出版许可于1604年9月获批，印刷工作于当年12月完成。

en.s: The siege of Nagpur was laid by Khan-i-Dauran, a high-ranking Mughal official to the fort of Nagpur, ruled by the Gond king of Deogarh, Kok Shah.

zh.s: 莫卧儿帝国高级官员汗·伊·道兰围攻那格浦尔要塞。当时，要塞由德奥加尔的贡德国王科克·沙阿统治。

en.t: Scottish Parliament ratifies the Treaty of Union
en.s: On 16 January 1707, the Parliament of Scotland passed the act ratifying the Treaty of Union by 110 votes to 69. The English act received royal assent on 6 March, and the union took effect on 1 May 1707.

zh.t: 苏格兰议会批准《联合法案》
zh.s: 1707年1月16日，苏格兰议会以110票赞成、69票反对通过批准联合条约的法案。英格兰的相应法案于3月6日获得御准，两国联合于1707年5月1日生效。

en.t: Royal dispatch of the Nueva Planta decree for Catalonia
en.s: On 16 January 1716, the Nueva Planta decree for Catalonia was dispatched by royal decree. It reorganized Catalonia’s governing and judicial institutions under the Spanish monarchy, replacing many earlier institutions.

zh.t: 加泰罗尼亚《新基本法令》正式颁发
zh.s: 1716年1月16日，针对加泰罗尼亚的《新基本法令》以王室敕令正式颁发。法令在西班牙王室统治下重组当地行政与司法机构，取代了许多原有制度。

en.s: The siege of Trichinopoly took place in early 1741 during an extended series of conflicts between the Nawab of Arcot and the Maratha Empire for control over parts of what is now southern India. Raghuji Bhonsle's Maratha Army successfully starved out the town, compelling the surrender of Chanda Sahib on 26 March 1741.

zh.s: 1741年初，阿尔科特纳瓦卜与马拉塔帝国为争夺今印度南部部分地区的控制权而持续交战，其间发生蒂鲁吉拉伯利围城战。拉古吉·邦斯勒率领马拉塔军队切断城内补给，最终迫使昌达·萨希卜于1741年3月26日投降。

en.s: The Battle of Cape St. Vincent (Spanish: Batalla del Cabo de San Vicente) was a fleet action fought off Cape St. Vincent on 16–17 January 1780 during the American Revolutionary War. A Royal Navy fleet under Admiral of the White Sir George Rodney defeated a smaller Spanish Navy fleet under Squadron Commander Juan de Lángara in what became known as the Moonlight Battle (batalla a la luz de la luna), unusual since the Age of Sail saw almost exclusively daytime battles.

zh.s: 1780年1月16日至17日，美国独立战争期间，英国与西班牙舰队在圣文森特角外海交战。英国海军白旗上将乔治·罗德尼爵士率舰队，击败胡安·德·兰加拉率领的较小西班牙舰队。战斗发生在夜间，因而被称为“月光海战”；在几乎都于白昼交战的风帆战舰时代，这并不寻常。

en.s: The Battle of Corunna (or A Coruña, La Corunna, La Coruña, Elviña or La Corogne) took place on 16 January 1809, when a French corps under Marshal of the Empire Nicolas Jean de Dieu Soult attacked a British army under Lieutenant-General Sir John Moore. The battle took place amidst the Peninsular War, which was a part of the wider Napoleonic Wars. It was a result of a French campaign, led by Napoleon, which had defeated the Spanish armies and caused the British army to withdraw to the coast following an unsuccessful attempt by Moore to attack Soult's corps and divert the French army.

zh.s: 1809年1月16日，法国帝国元帅尼古拉·让·德迪厄·苏尔特率领一支军团，进攻约翰·穆尔爵士中将指挥的英军，拉科鲁尼亚战役由此展开。此战也称埃尔维尼亚战役，属于拿破仑战争中的半岛战争。拿破仑此前率法军击败西班牙军队，穆尔试图攻击苏尔特军团、牵制法军，但未能成功，只得撤向海岸，最终引发这场战斗。

zh.s: 1813年1月16日至1814年1月2日，第六次反法同盟战争期间，俄军与普军围攻但泽。城中守军为让·拉普指挥的法国常驻部队，并吸收了从俄国战场撤退的大军团士兵增援。

en.s: The Hartley Colliery disaster (also known as the Hartley Pit disaster or Hester Pit disaster) was a coal mining accident in Northumberland, England that occurred on Thursday 16 January 1862 and resulted in the deaths of 204 men. The beam of the pit's pumping engine broke and fell down the shaft, trapping the men below.

zh.s: 1862年1月16日星期四，英格兰诺森伯兰郡发生哈特利煤矿灾难，也称赫斯特矿井灾难，造成204名男子死亡。矿井抽水机的横梁断裂，坠入井筒，把下方矿工困住。

en.s: The Battle of Plovdiv, or Battle of Philippopolis, was one of the final battles of the 1877–1878 Russo-Turkish War. Following the crushing Russian victory at the last battle of Shipka Pass, Russian commander Gen. Joseph Vladimirovich Gourko began to move southeast towards Constantinople. Blocking the route was the Ottoman fortress at Plovdiv under Suleiman Pasha. On 16 January 1878, a squadron of Russian dragoons led by Captain Alexander Burago stormed the city. Its defenses were strong but superior Russian numbers overwhelmed them and the Ottoman forces retreated almost to Constantinople. At this time foreign powers intervened and Russia agreed to the Treaty of San Stefano.

zh.s: 普罗夫迪夫战役，又称菲利波波利斯战役，是1877—1878年俄土战争的最后几场战斗之一。俄军在希普卡山口最后一战大胜后，约瑟夫·弗拉基米罗维奇·古尔科将军开始向东南的君士坦丁堡推进，前路被苏莱曼帕夏控制的普罗夫迪夫要塞阻挡。1878年1月16日，亚历山大·布拉戈上尉率一队俄国龙骑兵突入城市。守军防御虽强，但俄军凭人数优势将其压倒，奥斯曼军队几乎退至君士坦丁堡。此时列强介入，俄罗斯同意签订《圣斯特凡诺条约》。

en.s: President Chester A. Arthur signed the Pendleton Civil Service Reform Act on January 16, 1883. The law introduced competitive examinations and merit-based selection for covered federal posts.

en.t: Eighteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution
en.s: The Eighteenth Amendment (Amendment XVIII) of the United States Constitution effectively established the prohibition of alcoholic beverages in the United States by declaring the production, transport, and sale of alcohol (though not the consumption or private possession) illegal. The separate Volstead Act set down methods for enforcing the Eighteenth Amendment, and defined which "intoxicating liquors" were prohibited, and which were excluded from prohibition (e.g., for medical and religious purposes). The Amendment was the first to set a time delay before it would take effect following ratification, and the first to set a time limit for its ratification by the states.

zh.t: 美国宪法第十八修正案
zh.s: 美国宪法第十八修正案规定，生产、运输及销售酒类属于违法行为，由此确立禁酒制度，但不禁止饮用或私人持有。另行制定的《沃尔斯特德法》规定执行方式，并界定哪些“致醉酒类”受到禁止，哪些用途可以豁免，例如医疗及宗教用途。它也是首个规定获批准后延迟生效、并为各州批准程序设定期限的宪法修正案。

en.s: An election to Belfast Corporation took place in January 1920 as part of that year's Irish local elections. en.s: TWA Flight 3 was a twin-engine Douglas DC-3 propliner, registration NC1946, operated by Transcontinental and Western Air (TWA) as a scheduled domestic passenger flight from New York, New York, to Burbank, California, in the United States, via several stopovers including Las Vegas, Nevada. On January 16, 1942, at 19:20 PST, fifteen minutes after takeoff from Las Vegas Airport (now Nellis Air Force Base) bound for Burbank, the aircraft was destroyed when it crashed into a sheer cliff on Potosi Mountain, 32 miles (51 km) southwest of the airport, at an elevation of 7,770 ft (2,370 m) above sea level.

en.s: The siege of Urgun was a military engagement that took place during the Soviet–Afghan War. Between August 1983 and January 1984, Mujahideen forces laid siege to the town of Urgun, which was defended by a garrison of troops loyal to the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan. The mujahideen tried to take the town by storm using tanks, but despite making initial progress, they were eventually driven back and the siege was lifted.

en.t: Hu Yaobang resigns as CCP general secretary
en.s: On 16 January 1987, an enlarged meeting of the Chinese Communist Party Politburo accepted Hu Yaobang’s resignation as general secretary and selected Zhao Ziyang as acting general secretary. Hu retained his Politburo and Politburo Standing Committee seats.

zh.t: 胡耀邦辞去中共中央总书记职务
zh.s: 1987年1月16日，中共中央政治局扩大会议接受胡耀邦辞去总书记职务的请求，推选赵紫阳代理总书记。胡耀邦仍保留中央政治局委员和政治局常委职务。

en.t: George H. W. Bush announces the Gulf air campaign
en.s: On the evening of 16 January 1991 in Washington, President George H. W. Bush addressed the nation to announce that allied air forces had begun attacks on military targets in Iraq and Kuwait. It was already 17 January in the Gulf region.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Finland on 16 January 1994, with a second round on 6 February. It was the first time the President had been solely elected by a popular vote and saw Martti Ahtisaari defeat Elisabeth Rehn in the second round. Voter turnout was 78.4% in the first round and 78.7% in the second. This was an open presidential election, because the two-term Finnish President, Mauno Koivisto, had refused to seek a third term. zh.s: 2021年1月16日，尼日利亚伊莫州奥尔卢爆发战斗，交战双方为尼日利亚陆军，以及“比夫拉原住民”组织的武装分支“东部安全网络”。

en.s: The 2022 Supercopa de España final decided the winner of the 2022 Supercopa de España, the 38th edition of the annual Spanish football super cup competition. The match was played on 16 January 2022 at the King Fahd International Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The match was a clásico between 2020–21 Copa del Rey runners-up Athletic Bilbao and 2020–21 La Liga runners-up Real Madrid, the first time the clubs had met to directly compete for a trophy since the 1958 Copa del Generalísimo Final.

zh.s: 2022年1月16日，第38届西班牙超级杯决赛在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的法赫德国王国际体育场举行。对阵双方是2020—2021赛季国王杯亚军毕尔巴鄂竞技，以及同期西甲亚军皇家马德里。这是两支传统强队自1958年大元帅杯决赛以来，首次直接争夺一座冠军奖杯。

en.s: The 2024 Recopa Catarinense was the sixth edition of a state football "super-cup" tournament organized by the Federação Catarinense de Futebol (FCF). It was played in a single match between Criciúma, winner of the 2023 Campeonato Catarinense and Marcílio Dias, winner of the 2023 Copa Santa Catarina. The match, held on 16 January 2024, at the Estádio Heriberto Hülse, Criciúma emerged victorious with a score of 2-0 and won their first title of the tournament.

zh.s: 2024年1月16日，第六届圣卡塔琳娜优胜者杯在埃里贝托·乌尔塞体育场举行。这项州级超级杯由圣卡塔琳娜州足球协会组织，由2023年州联赛冠军克里西乌马对阵州杯冠军马西利奥迪亚斯。克里西乌马以2比0获胜，首次夺得该项冠军。

en.t: Opening attacks in the 2025 Catatumbo clashes
en.s: On 16 January 2025, National Liberation Army (ELN) militants launched attacks against FARC dissidents in Colombia’s Catatumbo region. These attacks marked the beginning of a new outbreak of armed violence in the region.

zh.s: 2025年1月16日，哥伦比亚民族解放军（ELN）武装人员在卡塔通博地区向哥伦比亚革命武装力量的异见派发动袭击，当地新一轮武装冲突由此开始。
